text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You sent that cardboard box the other day, 
right? Packed with... all sorts of stuff.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“—Huh? What?! I never said it was a 
nuisance or anything!”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway!! Tomorrow!! In the evening... 
Ah—be home after 6:00 PM, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean why... Who cares, it 
doesn't matter!! Besides, don't be 
wandering around so late! It's gonna get 
dark out, idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...A thank-you gift?! I-I'm not sending 
anything!! I'm just pushing off junk I 
don't need on you!! Anyway... just take 
it, dammit!!"
